user.title: Rhizome
user.description: Two settings matter: your frost dates, which anchor the whole calendar, and who receives the reminders.

data_description.langue: “Automatic” follows the Home Assistant language. This setting also applies to reminders, the calendar and entity names.
data_description.preset_climat: Preset that sets your frost dates. Pick "Custom dates" to enter your own.
data_description.gelees_derniere: Format MM-DD. The anchor for sowing and planting out.
data_description.gelees_premiere: Format MM-DD. The anchor for winter crops and tree planting.
data_description.notify_targets: Mobile apps get a "Done" button that fills in your journal in one tap.
data_description.rappel_jours: How long before a window opens. Adjustable per plant afterwards.
data_description.arrosage_actif: Enables watering reminders, based on each crop's frequency and the date you say you watered.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured: everything else is managed from the sidebar panel.

ajouter_plante.name: Add a plant
ajouter_plante.description: Adds a catalogue crop to the garden.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Garden zone; its offset shifts the whole calendar.

surnom.name: Nickname
surnom.description: To tell two plants of the same crop apart.

echelonnement_jours.name: Sow again every
echelonnement_jours.description: Interval in days for a staggered sowing. 0 disables it.

retirer_plante.name: Remove a plant
retirer_plante.description: Removes the plant and its journal.

uid.name: Plant
uid.description: Plant id, shown on its panel card.

entity_id.name: Plant entity
entity_id.description: An alternative to the uid: just point at the plant's sensor. Simpler in an automation.

marquer_seme.name: Log a sowing
marquer_seme.description: Records a sowing on its real date; the rest of the cycle is recomputed from it.

mode.name: Sowing mode
mode.description: "direct" goes straight to harvest; "interieur" adds a transplanting step.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free remark kept in the journal.

entity_id.name: Plant entity
entity_id.description: An alternative to the uid: just point at the plant's sensor. Simpler in an automation.

marquer_repique.name: Log a transplant
marquer_repique.description: Records planting out; harvest is recomputed from this date.

entity_id.name: Plant entity
entity_id.description: An alternative to the uid: just point at the plant's sensor. Simpler in an automation.

marquer_recolte.name: Log a harvest
marquer_recolte.description: Records a harvest; repeatable, quantities add up over the season.

entity_id.name: Plant entity
entity_id.description: An alternative to the uid: just point at the plant's sensor. Simpler in an automation.

marquer_perdu.name: Log a loss
marquer_perdu.description: The plant is lost; the cause stays in the journal for next season.

entity_id.name: Plant entity

marquer_termine.name: Close a crop
marquer_termine.description: The crop is done and asks for nothing more.

entity_id.name: Plant entity

annuler_dernier_evenement.name: Undo last journal entry

ressemer.name: Sow next batch
ressemer.description: Opens the next batch of a staggered sowing: a new plant of the same crop and zone, sown on the given date. The parent then stops asking.
